title: GPU detection runs twice per boot and probes wmic it does not need
description: Boot spends ~8 process spawns on GPU detection where 2 would do. Two independent causes. (1) resolveDownloadConfig caches the RESULT, assigned only after the await, so the two boot callers - GET /system/stats and GET /system/gpu-info, both fired by the landing hero stat slots - each see a null cache and run a full detection. Memoize the in-flight PROMISE instead. (2) detectAmdGPU and detectIntelArcGPU run the SAME 'wmic path win32_videocontroller get name' command, twice, in a Promise.all beside the NVIDIA probe, so they run even when nvidia-smi has already identified the card. Run wmic once, and only when NVIDIA is absent. Measured on Fabio's 4060 Ti: 4x wmic + 2x nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name + 2x bare nvidia-smi per boot; wmic is ~200ms each. Surfaced while fixing MPI-637 (the console windows) - these spawns are silent now but still waste.
